{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The group believes in the democratic road to socialist revolution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The group's urgent task is to build a socialist majority.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Only a majoritarian, popular movement can pave the democratic road to a socialist revolution.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"A radical democratization of politics, the economy, and society is possible.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group can achieve a radical democratization of politics, the economy, and society, in part, through winning governing power and passing transformational reforms for oppressed and working-class people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group can achieve a radical democratization of politics, the economy, and society, in part, through shop floor struggle in labor unions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The capitalist class will respond to advances by the working class with violence and repression.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Mass, democratic politics is the group's best defense against violence and repression by the capitalist class.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The group practices materialist politics.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The group is not practicing socialist identitarianism.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The group has a duty to win power and start building a better world now.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The group measures the success of its work and its adherence to socialist principles in terms of material outcomes.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Material outcomes include real changes to people's lives.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Material outcomes include quantifiable power and organizing scale for both the socialist movement and the broader working class.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The group wants to win.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Winning necessitates mass socialist politics.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Mass socialist politics involves organizing millions of everyday working-class and oppressed people to fight capitalism.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Mass socialist politics involves organizing millions of everyday working-class and oppressed people to build movements.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Mass socialist politics involves organizing millions of everyday working-class and oppressed people to transform the political terrain.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
